FAQ

Q: Why does temperature matter?

Different teas and coffees require specific temperatures. Green tea scorches at boiling while espresso needs 200F.

Q: Gooseneck vs regular?

Gooseneck kettles provide precise pour control ideal for pour-over coffee. Regular spouts are better for tea infusers.

Q: How long to boil?

Most kettles bring water to boil in 3-5 minutes. Higher wattage means faster boiling.

Final Verdict

The Fellow Stagg EKG is the premium choice for coffee and tea connoisseurs. Budget buyers should consider the Chefman Touch Temp.
